signalTypes.definition: Notebook entry that has matured enough to be promoted to canon (PoR or owned-context decision).
Notebook entry whose underlying problem is solved, obsolete, or duplicated.
signalTypes.evidenceMinimum: explicit superseding evidence or stale-window expiry

signalTypes.definition: Entry remains unresolved but should stay in the notebook.

evidenceRules: Notebook entries are debt, not authority. Never cite a notebook entry as canon.
Promotion requires evidence convergence; retirement requires explicit superseding signal.
Aging without resolution is acceptable; flagging without curation is not.

actionSelection.drop: Duplicate / obsolete / out-of-scope. Retire (delete) the entry.
actionSelection.observe: Entry remains valid debt; refresh metadata, no move.
actionSelection.promote-to-canon: Promote: file the matching owned-context decision (notebook-promotion or domain-specific).
actionSelection.file-decision: Operator should decide now (notebook-retirement, brand-guideline-update, meta-self-improvement, etc.).
actionSelection.capability-gap: Promotion blocked by missing capability; file capability-gap and leave the entry.
